title: Opaque ConfigMap drift causing Helm operator upgrade to fail; hotfix and automatic mitigation
creator: Maya Patel
description: Multiple on-prem customers reported operator crashes and stuck Helm upgrades during a coordinated platform release. Root cause: manual edits to operator-managed ConfigMaps (opaque application payloads and legacy annotation formats) caused a server-side patch conflict when the operator attempted to perform an in-place update. The Helm upgrade path assumes the operator can patch certain fields; when fields are mutated to an incompatible shape (immutable keys, changed payload types, or removed annotations), the operator enters an error loop and the Helm release remains in an upgrading state. This is exacerbated in Private/VPC installs where RBAC is minimal and operators run with strict admission controllers, so manual kubectl edits are the primary source of drift. Observability shows recurring pattern across k8s 1.22-1.25 clusters for three customers (support cases #INC-2026-114, #INC-2026-118, #INC-2026-125).
proposed_fix: 1) Ship operator-2.14.1-hotfix that: a) switches the operator's patch path to use server-side apply with managedFields to minimize conflicts; b) adds a 'preflight-drift-check' hook during Helm upgrades that detects opaque ConfigMap differences and surfaces a safe 'override' resource instead of editing the managed ConfigMap; c) when immutable-field conflicts are detected, create a namespaced 'config-overrides' object and migrate customer edits there so upgrades can proceed. 2) Add automatic backup of affected ConfigMaps to S3/NFS prior to upgrade for easy rollbacks. 3) Add a reconciliation loop to detect and convert manual edits into explicit overrides and emit a warning event in the Console. 4) Add a one-time migration job in the hotfix release for customers who already have drifted ConfigMaps.
rollout_plan: Canary rollout: 5% of operator fleet (internal staging and two low-risk customers) -> monitor for 24h -> 30% -> 100%. For on-prem customers we will provide an opt-in Helm chart patch to apply the operator hotfix; for managed Private clusters Redwood will perform the upgrade. Coordinate with Customer Success before upgrading any customer. Schedule maintenance window and notify customers via support ticket with step-by-step instructions and rollback steps.
test_plan: Unit tests for server-side apply paths and managedFields retention. Integration tests using k8s clusters (1.22, 1.24, 1.25) reproducing manual edits: changed keys, removed annotations, and immutable-field writes. End-to-end test: Helm upgrade with preflight-drift-check enabled should create 'config-overrides' and complete upgrade; rollback test uses backed-up ConfigMap to restore previous state. Add canary smoke-checks in Console (operator health, Helm release state, API error rates).
rollback_plan: If hotfix causes regressions, rollback to operator-2.14.0: Helm rollback will revert chart and operator deployment. Run the backup restore job to reapply pre-upgrade ConfigMaps. Communicate rollback to affected customers and open post-mortem. Ensure migration job is idempotent and reversible; have a script to convert 'config-overrides' back into the original ConfigMap if needed.
infra_notes: Operator will require permission to create/read ConfigMaps, create a new CRD 'ConfigOverride' (lightweight namespaced CRD), and write to the cluster's backup store (S3/NFS). For air-gapped environments, fallback to a local PVC backup. Verify RBAC templates for minimal privileges. Watch for clusters that disallow server-side apply (older k8s) and fall back to safe patch with conflict detection.
comments: 2026-02-27 Maya Patel: Triage complete. Incident numbers consolidated. Assigned to Luca. High customer impact; recommend P0. Notified CS and SRE. Starting safe mitigation path.

2026-02-28 Luca Moretti: Reproduced locally by manually editing managed ConfigMap keys and running Helm upgrade; operator crashed with 'invalid patch: trying to change immutable field'. Identified two distinct conflict classes: immutable keys and shape changes in opaque payloads.
2026-03-02 Engineering review: Agreed on server-side apply + managedFields approach; noted k8s <1.20 fallback required. Added migration job to convert manual edits into ConfigOverride CRs.
2026-03-04 SRE note: Added temporary alert that filters HelmUpgrade events and flags repeated 'UpgradeFailed' with 'patch conflict' as P0. Configured throttled notifications to on-call.
